Professional Summary
Senior product-focused designer with a strong background across product design and client-facing roles, combining user-centered design, B2B sales experience, and cross-functional collaboration. Comfortable working in Agile teams and driving end-to-end design from research to delivery. Notice period: 60 days.

Technical Skills
Figma, UX/UI Design, B2B Sales, SFDC, Git, Linux, Agile

- Implemented component-driven design system in Figma to reduce design-to-development handoff time by 35%; coordinated versioning and release process with engineers on Linux-based CI environments.

UI/UX Designer, Medisure (Jun 2020 - May 2025)
- Designed and launched a patient engagement web app using UX/UI Design principles; increased weekly active user retention by 22% through improved onboarding flows prototyped in Figma.
- Partnered with product and QA in Agile ceremonies, managing design assets in Git and ensuring consistent handoffs; used SFDC insights to inform feature prioritization with commercial teams.
- Conducted usability testing and A/B experiments, iterating on information architecture and interaction patterns to reduce support tickets related to navigation by 30%.

Account Executive, Zoho (Mar 2017 - May 2020)
- Managed a portfolio of enterprise clients, driving new B2B Sales opportunities and achieving quota through consultative engagement and solution demonstrations.
- Coordinated with product and implementation teams using SFDC to track pipeline and ensure smooth onboarding; translated customer requirements into product feedback that influenced UX/UI Design priorities.
- Conducted competitive analysis and presented tailored proposals, improving win rate in targeted segments by 18%.
